The commentator then claims he is discussing new "Trump accounts" from a recent Republican budget bill, which she frames as part of a Republican plan to take money from working Americans and give it to billionaires as a tax cut.

intended_effect: To alarm viewers and incite opposition to the Republican Party's economic policies by portraying them as harmful to ordinary Americans and beneficial only to the rich.
